title: Select Similar
tooltip: Selects every item that shares the property values you tick with the first selected item, in the whole model, its own model or the selection.

title: Filter Selection
tooltip: Keeps or removes the selected items whose property passes a test (equals, contains, greater than, is missing...) without running a new search.

title: Invert
tooltip: Selects everything the current selection leaves out, leaving hidden items out. With nothing selected it selects everything visible.

title: Select by File
tooltip: Selects every item of the appended files you tick, remembering your last choice.

title: Save as Set
tooltip: Saves the current selection as a selection set named from a template such as Ducts - 412 items - 2026-10-05, in the Playground folder.

title: Back
tooltip: Restores the selection you had before this one, like Back in a browser.

title: Forward
tooltip: Restores the next selection after going Back.

title: History
tooltip: Lists the selections made in this model (time, item count, main category) and restores the one you choose.

title: Pick Order
tooltip: Records the items you click, in the order you click them, so you can select, number, export or color them in that order.

title: Select Picked
tooltip: Selects the items in the pick list.

title: Number Picked
tooltip: Writes Playground > Sequence = 1, 2, 3... onto the picked items in pick order, keeping their other Playground properties. One undo step.

title: Export Picked
tooltip: Writes the pick list to Excel or CSV: order, name, category, Element ID, GUID, source file and centre point in model units.

title: Color Picked
tooltip: Colors the picked items from light to strong blue along the pick order. One undo step.

title: Clear Picked
tooltip: Empties the pick list of this model.

title: Quick Find
tooltip: Finds any element by name, Element ID, category, type, mark or level as you type. Enter selects and zooms, Shift+Enter selects every match.

title: Search Set Wizard
tooltip: Builds a search set step by step: where to search, conditions picked from the model's own properties and values, a live count, then name and folder.

title: Batch Sets
tooltip: Creates one search set per value of a property, such as one set per level, named and foldered from templates. One undo step.

title: Sets Library
tooltip: Publishes search sets to a shared library and imports them into other models, or renames and deletes libraries.

title: Export Sets
tooltip: Writes the sets you choose to a Playground XML file: search sets as conditions, selection sets as item references that survive into other files.

title: Import Sets
tooltip: Recreates sets and folders from a Playground XML file, finding static set items by path, GUID or Element ID, and reports what was found.

title: Repair Search In
tooltip: Finds search sets whose Search In scope is empty or points at models that are gone, and re-scopes them to matching models or the whole model.

title: What Is It
tooltip: Everything Navisworks knows about the selected item, or the one you click, in one card: identity, Revit IDs, source file and tree path, size and position, geometry, colour and state, and every property tab. A plain-text summary goes to the clipboard.

title: Properties Plus
tooltip: A window that follows the selection: pinned properties compared across every selected item (one value, or how many differ), and all of the first item's properties. Copy a value or select every item in the model that shares it.

title: Selection HUD
tooltip: Shows a small readout in the bottom-left corner of the Navisworks window: how many items and objects are selected, from which models, the top categories, and a summed property when you set one. Shift+Click chooses the property to sum.

title: Copy IDs
tooltip: Copies one row per selected element (name, Element ID, UniqueId, IFC GlobalId, InstanceGuid, source file, tree path) as tab-separated text with a header, ready to paste into Excel. Shift+Click chooses the columns.

title: Open in Explorer
tooltip: Shows the selected item's model file in Windows Explorer: the source file it was appended from, or its Navisworks cache file (asks when both exist). With nothing selected, shows this document's own file.

title: Property Explorer
tooltip: Scans the selection, the visible items or the whole model once, then lists every category, property and value with counts in three linked, searchable lists. Select the items with a value, save it as a search set, copy the list or export the whole index to Excel.

title: Count by Property
tooltip: Counts objects by the values of one property, or by pairs of values of two (a two-level pivot), over the selection, the visible items or the whole model. Shows a sorted table with shares and a top 20 chart, then lets you select any group. Optional Excel export.

title: Property Exporter
tooltip: Exports the properties you tick for the selected objects (or their geometry items) to a styled Excel workbook or a CSV file, with name, file, Element ID and GUID columns in front. Your choice is remembered and can be saved as a named template.

title: Data Validator
tooltip: Checks the model against BEP rules kept as JSON files in the team rules folder (every duct has a system name, every element a level, marks filled in, comments matching a pattern). Reports passes and failures per rule with element links, and can export to Excel and save a selection set per failing rule. Shift+Click opens or checks the rule files.

title: Bulk Property Writer
tooltip: Writes up to 10 custom properties to the selected items in one step, merged into an existing tab, or writes a spreadsheet's columns to the objects its Element ID, GUID or property column matches, with a preview of matched, unmatched and ambiguous rows first.

title: Find and Replace
tooltip: Finds text or a regular expression in property values (all properties or one) and replaces it after a preview. Native values are read-only, so corrections go to a Playground Corrected tab; values in custom tabs are edited in place.

title: Property Mapper
tooltip: Fills one standard tab (System, Level, Mark...) from whichever source property each model uses, in order of preference, with optional regex clean-up and per-model overrides. Shows coverage per field and model before writing. Profiles are team-shareable and export to JSON.

title: External Data Link
tooltip: Links a spreadsheet to this document by a key column (Element ID, GUID or a property) and writes its columns to a custom tab on the matched objects. Refresh re-reads the file and reports matched, unmatched and changed; links are saved with the document's Playground data.

title: Model Tree Export
tooltip: Exports the selection tree to a chosen depth (4 by default) as an Excel workbook with a sheet per model: each node's depth, name, class, descendants, geometry items and hidden state, indented and one column per level so it filters in Excel.

title: Clear Labels
tooltip: Removes the value labels Property Labels drew in the view.

title: Property Labels
tooltip: Draws a chosen property's value above each selected object in the view, on a short leader from the top of its box (up to 500 objects). Labels follow orbit and zoom; Clear Labels removes them.

title: Color by Property
tooltip: Colors every item by the value of a property you pick, most common values first, and lists the legend with counts. The same value keeps its color from one run to the next.

title: Color Presets
tooltip: Saves a color scheme as a named preset the whole team can apply, then repaints the model from it in one step. Manage renames, deletes, exports and imports presets.

title: Trade Ghost
tooltip: Keeps the trades you choose, or the selection, solid and fades every other model to a transparent grey. Click again to change the focus or clear the ghost. Shift+Click sets the transparency.

title: Status Painter
tooltip: Paints items by construction status (Installed, In progress, Planned, On hold, Issue), sets the status of the selection, and shows the legend. Shift+Click sets the colors and where the status is stored.

title: Legend Maker
tooltip: Draws the last color scheme as a print-ready PNG legend with swatches and counts, and can save a viewpoint that brings those colors back.

title: Match Appearance
tooltip: Copies the color and transparency of the first selected item to the rest of the selection, or to each object you click next until Esc.

title: Exploded View
tooltip: Spreads the selected objects or their models away from their common center as one undoable move, without touching the source files. Click again to collapse them back or spread them further.

title: Reset Overrides
tooltip: Puts back the model colors, transparency, hidden items, moved items or required and frozen flags you choose, all in one undo step.

title: Background
tooltip: Steps the view background through White, Light gradient, Dark gradient, Black and Horizon. Shift+Click picks one from the list or a custom color.

title: Presentation Mode
tooltip: Clears the screen for a meeting: minimizes the ribbon to its tabs, closes add-in panels and maximizes the window. Ctrl+Alt+F11 or a second click puts everything back. Shift+Click sets what changes.

title: Exit Presentation
tooltip: Leaves Presentation Mode and puts the ribbon, panels, window size and background back from anywhere.

title: Batch Viewpoints
tooltip: Saves a viewpoint for every level, grid intersection, selection or search set, or model in one go: plans cut at each level, eye-level views or zoomed sets, named and filed by template. One Ctrl+Z removes the batch.

title: Viewpoints from Excel
tooltip: Exports saved viewpoints to an Excel workbook (folder, name, eye, target, up, lens, comment) in model units, or creates and updates viewpoints from one by folder and name.

title: Export Viewpoints
tooltip: Exports only the saved viewpoints you tick, as a Navisworks viewpoints XML file for Import Viewpoints, or as a Playground package that keeps cameras, sections and comments for Viewpoint Sync.

title: Viewpoint Sync
tooltip: Copies viewpoint folders from one Navisworks file to another through a package: export the folders here, import them there into the folder you choose, skipping, replacing or keeping both when a name exists.

title: Where Am I
tooltip: One popup with where the camera is: the saved viewpoint it is on, eye coordinates, compass heading and pitch, nearest level and grid intersection, lens, section, models and selection. Copy puts it on the clipboard.

title: Viewpoints to Images
tooltip: Saves an image of every viewpoint you choose (PNG or JPG, 720p to 4K or a custom size, named by template) into a dated folder with an index.html contact sheet. Your view comes back afterwards.

title: Batch Images
tooltip: Saves images of saved viewpoints, clash results (by test and status) and Playground issues in one run, into Viewpoints, Clashes and Issues folders with one index.html contact sheet.

title: Batch PDF
tooltip: Prints the viewpoints you choose, in folder order or your own order, to one PDF handout: title page, contents, one page per view with its comments and a footer. A4, A3, Letter or Tabloid.

title: Level Sectioner
tooltip: Cuts the model at the level you choose: a section plane at the cut height above the floor, optionally the floors below hidden and a plan view. Levels come from the grid system or are estimated from the model. Shift+Click sets the cut.

title: Level Up
tooltip: Moves the level section to the next level up and says which level it is. Invisible on the ribbon; rebind it in the Shortcuts editor.

title: Level Down
tooltip: Moves the level section to the next level down and says which level it is. Invisible on the ribbon; rebind it in the Shortcuts editor.

title: Camera Sync
tooltip: Mirrors the camera live between two Navisworks windows on this computer, for two model versions side by side. Turn it on in both windows; the one you move leads.

title: Coordinate Spotter
tooltip: Click points in the view to drop numbered markers with their coordinates until Esc, then get the table, the clipboard copy and an Excel or CSV file. Shift+Click sets a local origin.

title: Clear Spots
tooltip: Removes the Coordinate Spotter markers from the view and starts the numbering again at P1.

title: Sheet Overlay
tooltip: Draws a DXF plan over the model at a level, placed by offset and rotation or by two reference points, with its texts as labels. Once placed, one click shows it again; Shift+Click places another.

title: Clear Sheet
tooltip: Removes the DXF sheet overlay and its labels from the view.

title: Clash Matrix
tooltip: Builds a battery of clash tests from a workbook of trades and an H, C or D test matrix, referencing selection sets so the tests follow model updates. Can also write a template to fill in.

title: Clash Templates
tooltip: Saves clash test definitions as named templates shared with your team, and builds them again in another model, naming any selection sets it cannot find.

title: Scan vs Model
tooltip: Runs a clearance test between laser scans (points) and the design, then colours each design element by how close the scan comes and lists the closest ones.

title: Clash Namer
tooltip: Renames clashes and result groups from a template like {test} {n:000} {grid} {level}, with a live before and after preview. Shift+Click sets when big tests are rebuilt instead.

title: Status Rules
tooltip: Applies ordered rules (depth, trades, age, element properties) that set clash statuses, assignees and comments, with a count of what each rule would change before anything is written.

title: Clash Assigner
tooltip: Assigns clash groups and ungrouped clashes to the trade that moves, keeps the ball-in-court history in the model, and shows who holds what and for how long. Shift+Click sets who moves first.

title: Clash to Viewpoints
tooltip: Saves a viewpoint for each chosen clash or group, in folders by test and group, with a comment giving its status, distance, elements, grid and level.

title: Clash Heatmap
tooltip: Colours elements by how many open clashes they have, lists the top hotspots, and can mark the densest spots in the view. Shift+Click clears the colours and markers.

title: Show in Revit
tooltip: Sends the selected elements to Revit, where the Playground Link button for pyRevit selects and zooms to them.

title: Show from Revit
tooltip: Selects and zooms to the elements sent from Revit with the Playground Link button for pyRevit.

title: Clash Excel
tooltip: Writes a styled Excel report of the chosen clash tests: a summary in Clash Detective's colours, then one sheet per test with a thumbnail of each clash, filters and frozen headers.

title: Clash Dashboard
tooltip: Builds a one-page HTML dashboard of the chosen clash tests (status, where the open clashes are, who holds them and for how long, groups and every clash) and opens it in your browser.

title: Count Matrix
tooltip: Counts open and new clashes trade against trade (or model against model) across the chosen tests, as heat tables in the output window and an optional workbook.

title: Snapshot
tooltip: Records the current results of the chosen clash tests as a snapshot that Clash Delta and Clash Trends compare with. Shift+Click to snapshot automatically on save, or to delete old snapshots.

title: Clash Delta
tooltip: Compares the chosen clash tests now with a snapshot: new, fixed and still open clashes and status changes, in the output window and an optional workbook.

title: Clash Trends
tooltip: Charts open and resolved clashes over the model's snapshots with a burn-down table, and can save it to Excel or CSV.

title: Per-Trade Reports
tooltip: Writes one clash workbook (and an optional dashboard) per responsible trade into a folder, with an index, using Clash Assigner's who-moves list for unassigned clashes.

title: RFI
tooltip: Click a point to raise a request for information there, from the RFI template, with the clicked object, the view and a snapshot.

title: Hold
tooltip: Click a point to put a hold on work there, from the Hold template (high priority, due in 3 days by default), with the clicked object, the view and a snapshot.

title: Verify
tooltip: Click a point to ask for a check on site or in the authoring model, from the Verify template, with the clicked object, the view and a snapshot.

title: Safety
tooltip: Click a point to raise a safety concern there, from the Safety template (critical, due tomorrow by default), with the clicked object, the view and a snapshot.

title: Stamp from Template
tooltip: Choose any issue template, then click where the issue goes. Templates are managed in Issue Templates.

title: Issue Pins
tooltip: Shows every open issue that has a location as a pin in the view, labelled with its number, type and title. The pins follow edits and come back when another model opens.

title: Meeting Mode
tooltip: Runs a coordination meeting through the issues you choose, one at a time, going to each in the view; change status, record decisions, reassign and set due dates as you go, then write the minutes as HTML and Excel.

title: Issue Templates
tooltip: Manage the issue templates (type, number prefix, title pattern, priority, trade, assignee, due days, description, labels) that new issues, stamps and Clash to Issues start from. Shared with the team when a shared folder is set.

title: Clash to Issues
tooltip: Turns each clash group and ungrouped clash of the chosen tests into an issue, once, with its clash view, snapshot and elements, and a trade, priority and due date from rules. Shift+Click sets the rules.

title: Coordination Report
tooltip: Writes the issue register as an HTML page and an Excel workbook: open, overdue and due-this-week counts, open issues by trade, priority and age, the overdue list, a section per trade with snapshots, and what closed recently. Shift+Click for formats and folder.

title: KPI Export
tooltip: Exports issues, comments, clash results, clash tests and clash history as CSV and JSON tables for Power BI, with a README describing every column. Shift+Click to set a fixed folder for scheduled refreshes.

title: BCF Export
tooltip: Writes Playground issues, or clash groups and clashes straight from Clash Detective, to a BCF 2.1 or 3.0 file with topics, comments, viewpoints in metres, IFC GUID components and snapshots, for Revit, Solibri, BIMcollab and other BCF tools.

title: BCF Import
tooltip: Reads a BCF 2.0, 2.1 or 3.0 file into the issue register, merging topics with the same GUID, saving their viewpoints under BCF in Saved Viewpoints and finding their components by IFC GUID or Revit Element ID.

title: Batch Append
tooltip: Appends many model files at once from a folder (optionally with its subfolders) or from a manifest list (txt, csv or xlsx with optional order and trade columns), after a preview that ticks only the files not appended yet.

title: Link Navigator
tooltip: From the selected element to the model it comes from: its files, units, transform, freshness and size in the output window, then select, isolate, hide, open the folder, refresh, remove it or show it in Source Files.

title: Transform Fixer
tooltip: Moves, turns about Z, re-units or resets whole models by typed values or two picked points, as one undo step, and saves or applies a transform preset per model file (optionally applied whenever that file is appended).

title: Folder Watch
tooltip: Watches the files of the appended models and, when one changes on disk, offers to refresh it with a small notice that never takes focus. Shift+Click to choose the folders, how often to check and whether to start with Navisworks.

title: Stale Files
tooltip: Compares every model's loaded file (the NWC) with its source file and lists the models whose source was saved later, whose file is missing, or whose source is not on this computer. Shift+Click to check automatically whenever a model opens.

title: Health Check
tooltip: Scores every appended model from 0 to 100 on units, distance from the origin, far-away objects, element IDs, duplicate appends, transforms and file age, with an HTML and Excel report. Shift+Click to set the thresholds and report formats.

title: Duplicate Finder
tooltip: Finds objects that are the same thing in the same place, within one model or across appended models, then selects the extra copies and saves them as a selection set.

title: Model Compare
tooltip: Compares two appended versions of a model, or a model with a snapshot you saved earlier, matching objects by their IDs. Added objects turn green, changed amber and removed red, with Compare selection sets and an Excel list.

title: Preflight
tooltip: Checks the document is ready to share against a profile: saved, models current, clash tests run after the newest models, no stray hidden items, overrides or section. Shift+Click to edit the profiles.

title: Session Stats
tooltip: Measures every appended model (file sizes, items, geometry items, primitives, fragments, extent, units, when it arrived and how long it took to load) in a table and a chart, and saves the table as an Excel workbook beside the document.

title: NWD Publisher
tooltip: Publishes the document as a numbered NWD with title, author and expiry, after a Preflight, and moves older versions into an Archive folder.

title: Model Wipe
tooltip: Removes the kinds of data you choose from the document, such as saved viewpoints, selection sets, clash tests, overrides and Playground data, after showing exactly how much will go.

title: TimeLiner from Excel
tooltip: Builds or updates TimeLiner tasks from an Excel or CSV schedule (Task ID, Parent ID or WBS, dates, task type, attachments, progress), checking every row before anything changes. Write a template first to start from the tasks already in the model.

title: Auto Attach
tooltip: Attaches model items to TimeLiner tasks by rules, such as task names like L3 Ducts to items on Level 3 in the duct layer, or names containing Slab to a selection set. Previews every task first and attaches in one undo step. Shift+Click loads saved rule templates.

title: Progress Painter
tooltip: Sets the percent complete of the selected objects (a Playground > Progress property) and updates the TimeLiner progress of the tasks that hold them, or paints the model in four progress bands with a legend.

title: 4D Movie Maker
tooltip: Renders a construction sequence from TimeLiner dates and task types, one stamped frame per day or week, as PNG frames, an HTML player and an MP4 when ffmpeg is installed. Visibility and colours are put back exactly afterwards, even on cancel.

title: TimeLiner Export
tooltip: Exports every TimeLiner task to a styled Excel workbook: outline numbers and indented names, planned and actual dates, durations, type, progress, status, attachments and user columns.

title: Schedule Health
tooltip: Checks the TimeLiner schedule for tasks with nothing attached, missing or reversed dates, zero durations, objects in several tasks and objects in no task, scores it out of 100 and opens the report. Shift+Click for options.

title: Quick Takeoff
tooltip: Counts and measures objects (length, area, volume, weight from Revit and IFC properties, or from geometry) grouped by one or two properties, with subtotals and totals. Export to Excel, select any group, or save the setup as a template.

title: Zone Takeoff
tooltip: Measures objects by zone, from grid levels, rooms or areas, grid bays or square tiles, and by group. Exports an Excel pivot with a sheet per zone.

title: Takeoff Templates
tooltip: Lists the saved Quick and Zone Takeoff templates, shared with the team when Playground uses a shared folder. Run, rename, duplicate, delete, export or import them.

title: COG Calculator
tooltip: Weighs the selected objects from closed-mesh volumes and material densities (or their Weight property), marks the combined centre of gravity in the view and lists every object with its weight, centroid and method. Shift+Click for densities.

title: QR Tagger
tooltip: Makes a QR code for each selected object from a payload template (project, file, Element ID, IFC GUID or a URL), saved as PNG files with a printable A4 label sheet, and writes the payload into the object as Playground > QR.

title: Photo Pins
tooltip: Pins site photos to a point you click in the model, with a caption and the level, grid and object found there, and draws the pins in the view. The photos are copied beside the model's data. Shift+Click to show or hide the pins.

title: Photo Browser
tooltip: Shows this model's photo pins as thumbnails grouped by level, grid or linked object. Filter them, go to a pin's view and object, open a photo, delete a pin or export an HTML photo report.

title: Field Checklists
tooltip: Inspection checklists attached to saved viewpoints: Pass, Fail or N/A with notes per item, inspector, date and sign-off, stepping from viewpoint to viewpoint, with an HTML and Excel report. Shift+Click edits the team's templates.

title: Geometry Exporter
tooltip: Exports the selected objects' own triangles with their colours to glTF (.glb), OBJ, STL or DXF 3D faces, adding IDs and chosen properties in glTF. Big selections are budgeted and anything skipped is listed.

title: IFC Exporter
tooltip: Writes the selected objects to an IFC4 file with storeys from their levels, IFC classes from their categories, colours, GlobalIds and property sets. Shift+Click to change which IFC class a category becomes.

title: Command Palette
tooltip: Type a few letters to run any pyNavis or Navisworks command, go to a saved view or select a set. Recently used ones come first.

title: Record Macro
tooltip: Records the pyNavis commands you run next, so Play Macro can repeat them in order.

title: Play Macro
tooltip: Runs a saved macro, one command after another. Dialogs inside its commands still ask you; click again to stop a playing macro.

title: Manage Macros
tooltip: Rename, reorder, add pauses, questions or Navisworks commands to, export or import your macros.

title: Macro to Button
tooltip: Makes a ribbon button in your MyTools extension that plays a macro, with its own icon and shortcut.

title: Report Templates
tooltip: Every saved template of every Playground report in one list, to run without dialogs, edit, duplicate, delete, export or import. Reports not built yet show as unavailable.

title: Scheduled Reports
tooltip: Runs report templates on a model on a timetable through Windows Task Scheduler and the pyNavis command line runner, then mails or copies the results.

title: Button Maker
tooltip: Makes a new ribbon button in your MyTools extension from a template or your own script, with an icon and an optional shortcut.

title: Script Editor
tooltip: Edits the scripts of your own extensions beside Navisworks, with line numbers, completion, a syntax check on save and F5 to run.

title: Hotkey Manager
tooltip: Gives any pyNavis button or Navisworks ribbon command a keyboard shortcut, or takes one away, and checks for clashes.

title: Extension Manager
tooltip: Installs, updates and removes pyNavis extensions listed in your team registry. Shift+Click sets the registry.

title: Team Sync
tooltip: Pulls the team's templates, presets, rules, shortcuts and project settings from the team folder, or pushes yours to it.

title: Usage Analytics
tooltip: Shows which tools are used, when and by whom, and which are never used. Opt-in, and it never records document names. Shift+Click for settings and Excel export.

title: Environment Doctor
tooltip: Checks Navisworks, pyNavis, engines, extensions, shortcuts, panels, add-ins, folders and the log, and reports what needs attention. Shift+Click copies the report as text.

title: Playground Settings
tooltip: Sets your name, the project and company, where Playground keeps team data, the trades and trade rules, report units and the date format.

title: Unit Converter
tooltip: Converts lengths, areas, volumes and masses as you type, like 12' 6" to mm or 250 sqft in m2. Enter copies the result.
